body:
Asha (CS): quick weekly helixapps check-in — p95/p99 latency by route + streaming vs non-streaming attached below, noticed a small spike on streaming generate.
Elliot (Eng): thanks, dropping the numbers here from our telemetry window 2026-03-13 -> 2026-03-19:
Elliot (Eng): ```\nroute: /v1/generate - model: redwood-3b-q4
  streaming: p95=180ms p99=420ms error_rate=0.9%
  non-streaming: p95=210ms p99=480ms error_rate=1.1%
route: /v1/chat - model: redwood-chat-7b
  streaming: p95=95ms p99=250ms error_rate=0.3%
  non-streaming: p95=120ms p99=310ms error_rate=0.4%
route: /v1/embeddings - model: redwood-embed-2.1
  (non-streaming only) p95=60ms p99=110ms error_rate=0.05%
``` 
Asha (CS): ok so generate streaming p99 hit 420ms, that's ~30% worse than last week — Helix said they're sensitive to tail latency for realtime suggestions.
Jonas (Prod): client reported more small requests after onboarding batch turned on. They increased client-side concurrent streams from 2->5 last Tue.
Elliot (Eng): noted. I see a kernel change rolled 2026-03-15 to prioritize larger batch paths; might be hurting small streaming tails. I'll schedule a quick rollback for that kernel flag to test.
Elliot (Eng): quick plan: 1) rollback kernel flag in canary tonight, 2) re-run telemetry, 3) if p99 drops by >15% push broadly. ETA 6-8h for canary window.
Asha (CS): thanks. On spend/usage: Helix monthly spend up 28% QoQ, usage pattern shows more short streaming calls which increases RPCs. Flagging renewal touchpoint — they may ask about cost optimization.
Jonas (Prod): can we recommend batching suggestions + switch to non-streaming for bulk scoring? I'll draft a short enablement note for Helix.
sre-bot: incident-check: no infra incidents in window; autoscaler events: 3 scale-ups (GPU pool) on 2026-03-16 02:14 UTC.
Asha (CS): next steps: Elliot validate rollback impact, Jonas prepare enablement note with 3 playbook items (batching, non-streaming bulk, model variant with lower mem), I'll sync with AM and schedule renewal prep if spend trend continues. :thumbsup:
Elliot (Eng): will post results in this thread after canary.
Jonas (Prod): I'll attach the enablement draft by EOD tomorrow.
Asha (CS): perfect — thanks team. If we see p99 <360ms after rollback we mark as mitigated for customer update.
